responsibility: This file provides the DFA scheduling model for the RMI XLR processor. It uses a simple main pipeline plus a separate non-pipelined multiply/divide automaton to assign latencies and resource usage for integer ALU, condition-move, load/store, prefetch, branch, coprocessor-transfer, HI/LO, multiply, divide, atomic, and synchronization-loop instructions, giving GCC a compact XLR-specific timing model distinct from the more feature-rich XLP description.
